description: Calculate total daily energy consumption from a list of electrical loads. Each load specifies its power draw, how many hours per day it runs, and quantity. Returns total daily energy (Wh and Ah), peak power draw, and average power. This is typically the first step in sizing a battery bank and solar system.

loads.description: List of electrical loads to include in the budget

hoursPerDay.description: Average hours of use per day

powerWatts.description: Power consumption of a single unit in watts

name: calculate_power_budget
title: Power Budget / Energy Audit
